select tab.receiptStatus,tab.isPrint,sum(qtyDifferences) as qtyDifferences,sum(count) as count from ( SELECT do2.id, do2.receipt_status AS receiptStatus, do2.is_print AS isPrint, case when ( SELECT COUNT ( 1 ) FROM delivery_order_detail doe WHERE doe.main_id = do2.ID AND doe.delivery_qty != doe.receive_qty and doe.is_deleted = false ) >0 then 1 else 0 end AS qtyDifferences, COUNT ( 1 ) AS COUNT FROM delivery_order do2 WHERE do2.is_deleted = FALSE
AND do2.supplier_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY do2.receipt_status, do2.is_print, do2.id ) tab group by tab.receiptStatus,tab.isPrint
